scenes.headline: CLAUDE SLIDES & DOCS *NOW FREE*
scenes.sub: Docs, Slides and Design on the free plan
scenes.say: Claude Slides, Docs and Design just left beta, and now they're on the free plan.
Ask for a launch deck, and it builds every slide right in the chat.
Then it turns a slide into social posts in four sizes.
Docs too, and exports keep your formatting in PowerPoint, {PDF|P D F} or Google Slides.

scenes.heading: ALREADY *MADE*
scenes.label: docs, decks & designs in Claude
scenes.say: People have already made over {45|forty-five} million of them.
And new Claude Motion turns a report into an animated video you can download.
The catch: Motion is Team and Enterprise only, and Dashboards need a paid plan. But Docs, Slides and Design are free for everyone.
What would you make first? Comment {DECK|deck}.

youtube.title: Claude Slides, Docs & Design Are Now Free
youtube.description:
Claude Slides, Docs and Design left beta on October 8 and are now on every Claude plan, including Free. Ask for a deck and Claude builds the slides in the chat, turns a slide into social posts in four sizes, and writes docs; PowerPoint and PDF exports keep your formatting, and decks go to Google Slides.
Also new: Claude Motion turns a report into an animated MP4 (Team and Enterprise beta), and Claude Dashboards (paid plans, beta).
Footage: Anthropic official videos. Source: claude.com.
